title: Finch Circle Sale-Work Allowance Schedule — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
The member's sale-work allowance is the amount of complimentary basic work Marlowe & Finch Alterations extends on a garment bought at sale price, set by the member's tier in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program.

| Customer | Member's sale-work allowance |
|---|---|
| Active member at Finch Circle Diamond or Icon (a tier whose qualifying spend threshold is 5000.00 USD or more) | 20.00 USD |
| Active Finch Circle Platinum member (tier threshold 2500.00 USD, below 5000.00 USD) | 14.00 USD |
| Active Finch Circle Gold member (tier threshold 1200.00 USD, below 2500.00 USD) | 8.00 USD |
| Anyone else | nothing, so that nothing is waived |

**Records read.** The tier of the customer's Finch Circle membership and whether it is active.

## Tier edges, both sides

| Tier qualifying spend threshold (active membership) | Allowance |
|---|---|
| below 1200.00 USD (Finch Circle Member, Silver) | nothing |
| 1200.00 USD (Gold) | 8.00 USD |
| 2500.00 USD (Platinum) | 14.00 USD |
| 5000.00 USD or more (Diamond, Icon) | 20.00 USD |

A Diamond membership that is not active gives nothing.
